dialogues.speaker: Ahoyne
dialogues.text: An easy-breezy Natlan in an easy-breezy summer! Welcome to Wavey Bay! Want to give our Colorful Return to Sender challenge a try? You can start from over here.

dialogues.speaker: Ahoyne
dialogues.text: Great job on completing the basic challenge! If you want to continue, there'll be more than one saurian joining you in the contest.

dialogues.speaker: Ahoyne
dialogues.text: Congratulations on completing the intermediate challenge. Only the highest difficulty awaits you, with four saurians in the contest this time. Want to knock it out in one go?

dialogues.speaker: Ahoyne
dialogues.text: Impressive, dear guest. The rewards we've prepared aren't enough for one of your talents.
